items.exampleEn: He voluntarily gave up his seat to an older passenger.
items.exampleZh: 他主動把座位讓給一位年長的乘客。

items.exampleEn: Learning a new language can be a daunting task.
items.exampleZh: 學一種新語言可能是一項艱鉅的任務。

items.exampleEn: Many children crave attention from their parents.
items.exampleZh: 許多孩子都渴望得到父母的關注。

items.exampleEn: Even at seventy, she has a great lust for life.
items.exampleZh: 即使七十歲了，她依然非常熱愛生活。

items.exampleEn: It was wicked of him to lie to his little sister.
items.exampleZh: 他對妹妹說謊，真是太壞心了。

items.exampleEn: The novel explores the psyche of a lonely man.
items.exampleZh: 這部小說探索一個孤單男人的內心世界。

items.exampleEn: The wind blew fiercely all night.
I marvel at how much work she gets done every day.
items.exampleZh: 她每天能完成那麼多工作，真令我驚嘆。

items.sentenceEn: Climbing the mountain alone seemed daunting at first.
items.sentenceZh: 一個人爬那座山，起初看起來令人卻步。

items.audioEn: After a long week, I always crave a big bowl of hot soup.
items.audioZh: 忙了一整週之後，我總是很想喝一大碗熱湯。
items.questionZh: 說話者忙了一週之後很想要什麼？
options: A quiet day at the beach

items.sentenceEn: The two teams competed fiercely for the title.
items.sentenceZh: 兩支隊伍激烈地爭奪冠軍。

items.sentenceEn: We marveled at the size of the old tree.
items.sentenceZh: 我們對那棵老樹的大小嘖嘖稱奇。

items.stemEn: After weeks of rain, I really ____ some sunshine.
items.stemZh: 下了好幾個星期的雨，我真的好想要一點陽光。

items.stemEn: She left her job ____; nobody forced her to go.
items.stemZh: 她是自願離職的，沒有人逼她走。

items.passageEn: As a child, Ana's brother Jun had a lust for adventure. He read stories about wicked pirates and brave explorers, and he marveled at maps of faraway places. His parents worried, but they understood that adventure was part of his psyche. He learned the rudiments of sailing at a summer camp, and at twenty, he voluntarily joined a team that travels around the world by boat to study the ocean. The first storm was daunting, and the team had to fight fiercely to keep the boat safe. Still, Jun says he would not change anything. "I will always crave the open sea," he wrote in his latest letter home.
items.passageZh: Ana 的兄弟 Jun 從小就渴望冒險。他讀邪惡海盜和勇敢探險家的故事，也對遙遠地方的地圖驚嘆不已。他的父母很擔心，但他們明白冒險是他天性的一部分。他在夏令營學會了駕船的基礎，二十歲時，自願加入一個搭船環遊世界、研究海洋的團隊。第一場暴風雨令人害怕，團隊得拚命奮戰才保住船的安全。儘管如此，Jun 說他什麼都不想改變。他在最近寄回家的信中寫道：「我永遠都會渴望那片廣闊的大海。」

questions.questionZh: Jun 小時候喜歡讀什麼故事？
options: 關於太空和外星人的科學故事

questions.questionZh: Jun 二十歲時做了什麼？
options: 自願加入海洋研究航行隊

items.promptZh: 故事裡那個邪惡的皇后把王子變成了青蛙。
referenceEn: The wicked queen in the story turned the prince into a frog.
In the story, the wicked queen changed the prince into a frog.
rubricZh: wicked 表示「邪惡的」（例如 the wicked queen、was wicked 等）
「把⋯變成」可寫，例如 turn…into、change…into 等

items.promptZh: 在城市住久了，他渴望安靜的鄉村生活。
referenceEn: He has lived in the city for years and now craves a quiet life in the countryside.
Having lived in the city for so long, he craves the peace of country life.
rubricZh: 「渴望」用 crave＋名詞（例如 craves a quiet life 等）
「鄉村生活」可寫，例如 life in the countryside、country life 等
時態配合內容（例如 craves、has started to crave 等）；過去式、現在完成式都正確

resolvedAfterFinalReview.message: 執行長第②③關裁示修正：疑似：they never tried to change his psyche 搭配不自然（psyche 指心靈／心理結構，「改變孩子的性格」宜作 change his nature／his personality）
resolvedAfterFinalReview.resolution: 改為 "they understood that adventure was part of his psyche"；另把 last letter 改 latest letter，避免讀成「最後一封信」

resolvedAfterFinalReview.message: 執行長第②③關裁示修正：characterization 再次當干擾項（跨課重複），且詞性與副詞空格不同
resolvedAfterFinalReview.resolution: characterization、wicked 換成 fiercely、cynically（副詞，放得進空格但語意不通）

resolvedAfterFinalReview.message: 執行長第②③關裁示修正：干擾項 dig 為低級字、一眼可排除，且 dig 在 u03-l03 q14 已用過
resolvedAfterFinalReview.resolution: dig 換成 implicate（u07-l02，I really implicate some sunshine 不通；dig 口語亦可表「喜歡」）
